'''Bim Gizzo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who worked during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] for the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. At some point, he and his partner [[Brom (thug)|Brom]] attempted to plant a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] belonging to their employer's rival, [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], onto a patron at the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] the [[Sleeping Rancor]]. A pair of Industrial Automaton security personnel then arrived looking for the card and a fight ensued. During the fight Brom shot a sleeping [[Ronto/Legends|Ronto]] outside the bar, which then when on rampage, causing significant damage to the cantina.
